text: language chooser on login + settings, both clients, device-local

Done in 1f81c60. Key design point: the Android screens take hoisted selectedLocale/onSelectLocale rather than a second hiltViewModel() default. The default broke four Compose tests — LoginScreenTest and SettingsScreenTest render the screens directly against a fake ViewModel in a bare ComponentActivity, which is not a Hilt component. Hoisting keeps the screens Hilt-free (the property those tests depend on) and Nav, already inside the Hilt graph, owns the LocaleViewModel. The four tests pass unchanged. Also fixed an incomplete T-111 extraction that this ticket exposed: that sweep's regex only matched single-line >Text< and missed 34 multi-line JSX text nodes on web, plus ListKind.label and the Status chip labels on Android. Both clients re-swept clean with all three patterns.
